description: Offline-first integration between GitHub Spec Kit and ACKit, mapping specification artifacts into deterministic tasks, verification, completion gates and handoffs.
rules: Use docs/guides/feature-index.md to locate implemented CLI, verification, Spec Kit extension and handoff features; consult docs/reference/cli.md for exact commands.
Spec Kit is the source of specifications; ACKit is the source of tasks and evidence; the bridge coordinates them and does not replace either.
Completion is allowed only after a fresh PASS verdict; any subject mutation invalidates an old verdict, and stalePolicy fail must not be bypassed.
The bridge runtime is offline-first with redacted evidence, path containment and argv-array subprocess calls; Docs7/Context7 hosting is opt-in and separate from runtime.
Do not present archived task records or historical release descriptions as current runtime behavior.
